title: apinella pumila
intro: Apinella pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Hemlock, is a perennial plant species native to Europe, North Africa, and Western Asia. The health benefits of Apinella pumila include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Apinella pumila include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
